summary: First test run on BookShelf (German book-tracking PWA). Both backend and frontend validated end-to-end. All 16 pytest backend tests pass (auth incl. logout invalidation, books CRUD, cross-user isolation 404, filters, taxonomy, authors, stats, search w/ Open Library fallback). Frontend login, library grouping, add-book drawer, search (Open Library fallback), book detail (status/rating/progress/edit/delete selectors all present and interactive), calendar June 2026 spans visible for seeded books, stats page, settings theme toggle (light<->dark), logout and mobile viewport (390x844) tab bar all working. No critical issues found.

issues: Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' at initial mount – chart still renders correctly on resize but console shows warning (minor)

action_items: Note for review-request spec: actual testIds in code are `add-collections` (not `add-collections-button`), `add-name-input`, and `add-name-submit` (not `add-name-confirm`). The Add-Collection flow works correctly; this is only a documentation mismatch.
Optional: silence Recharts initial-mount warnings on Stats page by setting a minimum height on ResponsiveContainer (cosmetic only).
critical_code_review_comments: Clean separation: auth_utils, routers/*, models.py. No MongoDB ObjectId leakage (all finds use projection {"_id": 0}).
Password hashing uses bcrypt properly; session cookie set with secure+samesite=none; Bearer token also accepted.
books.normalize() correctly handles status→finished auto end_date/progress and pages<->percent recalculation (verified by test).
test_credentials: lara@test.de / lara1234 (seeded user). Tests also register disposable TEST_* users.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_* users and books via API, cleaned up by DELETE in-test. One UI-created book 'TEST_UI_*' (status to_read) remains in Lara's library from the frontend add-book test – harmless but main agent may delete if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all critical endpoints and can be reused as regression. Google Books API returns 429 from this env – Open Library fallback is used and works. Theme toggle requires clicking the child button ('Hell' / 'Dunkel') inside the segmented control (data-testid='theme-toggle' is on the wrapper div, not the buttons). Calendar current date is Oct 2026, use 4x calendar-prev to reach June 2026. Correct taxonomy add testIds: add-collections / add-categories / add-places / add-series → opens add-name-dialog → add-name-input + add-name-submit.
